Summary.en: Enables speech-to-text dictation via a self-hosted Whisper model (GDPR-compliant).
Summary.de: Aktiviert Sprache-zu-Text-Diktat über ein selbst gehostetes Whisper-Modell (DSGVO-konform).
Summary.it: Abilita la dettatura vocale tramite un modello Whisper self-hosted (conforme al GDPR).

Parameter.VoiceHotkey: Keyboard shortcut to toggle recording. Default: Alt+A.
Parameter.Language: Two-letter language code for Whisper (e.g. de, en, fr). If omitted, Whisper auto-detects the language.
Parameter.Placeholder: Custom placeholder text for the field. Only shown when ShowHint is true.
Parameter.ShowHint: If set to true, shows the hotkey hint as placeholder text. Default: false.

VoiceHotkey.default: Keyboard shortcut to toggle recording. Default: Alt+A.

Language.default: Two-letter language code for Whisper (e.g. de, en, fr). If omitted, Whisper auto-detects the language.

Placeholder.default: Custom placeholder text for the field. Only shown when ShowHint is true.

ShowHint.default: if set to true, shows the hotkey hint as placeholder text. default: false.
